sources.title: Chen and Aihara (1997), Chaos and Asymptotical Stability in Discrete-time Neural Networks
sources.finding: Leaky sigmoid recurrences and chaotic dynamics are prior art. The displayed recurrence lacks the explicit radial feedback used here.
sources.limits: No full-proof audit or nonlinear-conjugacy exclusion.

sources.title: Verzelli, Alippi and Livi (2019), Echo State Networks with Self-Normalizing Activations on the Hyper-Sphere
sources.finding: Radial neural normalization is established. Autonomous normalized-linear power iteration differs from the posterior-plus-residual formula.
sources.limits: Later Lyapunov arguments not independently verified or used as a general exclusion theorem.

sources.title: Sibel, Reynal and Declercq, Evidence of chaos in the Belief Propagation for LDPC codes
sources.finding: Chaotic iterative decoding is prior art. The graph-message state differs from this exact three-spin posterior with sphere feedback.
sources.limits: No figure audit, numerical replay or complete equivalence test.

sources.title: Reiter (1996), Attractors with the Symmetry of the n-Cube
sources.reviewed: Abstract, Sections 1-2 through Theorem 2.2 and start of proof.
sources.finding: Equivariant polynomial cube maps and parameter searches predate this study.
sources.limits: Full figure comparison not completed. Local PDF download failed certificate verification; an alternate download and web screenshot timed out.

sources.title: Brisson et al. (1996), Symmetric Attractors in Three-dimensional Space
sources.finding: Spatial cube-symmetric attractors are prior art.

sources.title: Reiter (1997), Chaotic Attractors with the Symmetry of the Tetrahedron
sources.finding: Tetrahedral chaotic attractors are prior art.

sources.title: Reiter (1999), Chaotic Attractors with the Symmetry of the Dodecahedron
sources.reviewed: Abstract, Sections 1-3, both reproducibility appendices; Figures 1-2 visually inspected on PDF page 8.
sources.finding: Group-averaged polynomial maps already produce threads, loops and diffuse spatial interiors. The paper uses density thresholds and blob surfaces, unlike the current unsmoothed state histograms.
sources.limits: No numerical reconstruction or conjugacy exclusion. Downloaded copyrighted PDF and page image remain external.

sources.title: Toker, Sommer and D'Esposito (2020), A simple method for detecting chaos in nature
sources.reviewed: Indexed primary full-text methods excerpt: Hyperchaotic generalized Henon map, equation (12), parameters a=1.76, b=0.1.
sources.finding: A three-dimensional delayed quadratic recurrence is an established hyperchaotic reference.
sources.limits: Direct publisher open redirected to inaccessible cookie authorization. Review uses the primary indexed text, not an independent numerical reproduction or audit of the cited original generalized Henon paper.
